text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ryoka Tsurugi mentioned having something to consult about, and when we met up one day—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to everyone's support, the U.A.F. has generated more
excitement than anticipated, and the scale of the tournament
is growing beyond our initial plans."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
In light of this, some of the athlete Umamusume spoke up,
saying they'd like to put on an event to delight the spectators who come to watch—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
So! I was thinking, how about holding
a ceremony live after the U.A.F. finals
featuring an original song?!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Winning Live in the Twinkle Series,
I want to create a place where athletes and fans
can share that same burning passion together.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: And so... we would absolutely love for you to participate in this ceremony live as well, <chrname>-san.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —The success of <chrname> and her Trainer was indispensable in building up the excitement for the U.A.F.!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure all the spectators coming to watch
would be thrilled to see you giving it your all,
<chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I'm scheduled to perform in the ceremony live too,
so please, do consider it!!
I want to fire things up with a huge bang together!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, once I shared the details about the ceremony live, <chrname> also agreed with its purpose and declared their participation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both Ryoka Tsurugi and Sonon Elfi were thrilled, and thus, holding a ceremony live was officially decided...!
